name: Glenhoff Stube & Tapas
address: 1 1st Ave, R102, Klein Brak River, 6500, South Africa
description_short: German-inspired brewery and tapas spot with craft beers and hearty fare near Klein Brak River.
description_long:
Glenhoff Stube & Tapas brings a taste of Bavaria to the Garden Route, combining craft brewery vibes with relaxed tapas-style dining. Located just off the R102 near Klein Brak River, this spot appeals to those looking for something different from the usual coastal fare—think German-inspired dishes alongside small plates, washed down with their own brews.

The atmosphere leans casual and convivial, with a brewery-meets-beer-garden feel that works well for groups or a lazy afternoon stop. It's the kind of place where you can settle in with a tasting paddle and graze through sharing plates. The location makes it an easy detour between Mossel Bay and George, particularly if you're after craft beer and something more substantial than bar snacks.
